programs.title: Girl Meets Farm: Midwest Delicatesse
programs.desc: Molly Yeh and her husband, Nick, are missing the Big Apple -- especially the food -- so to crush the craving, she whips up pastrami sandwiches with onion rings, hearty chicken kreplach soup and, for dessert, beautiful black and pink cookies.

programs.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations

programs.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programs.desc: Andrew Zimmern shares a tour of the Iowa State Fair  fresh, locally grown sweet corn, baked sausage cavatelli and Dutch letter pastries  sandwiches like fried pork tenderloin, loose ground beef and the Italian Gizmo.

programs.desc: A mom, dad, son and aunt who work in the same restaurant compete  in the first round, one family member's grill pan gets taken over by two relatives  in the entrée round, chicken breasts and mystery ingredients.

programs.title: Beat Bobby Flay
